name: Consumption statement
description: Statement grouping consumption amounts for allocation, encoding and accounting integration.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.help: All related records must belong to this condominium.

fiscal_year_id.label: Fiscal year
fiscal_year_id.description: Fiscal year associated with the statement.
fiscal_year_id.help: Its start date is used for the first statement of a file.

fiscal_period_id.label: Fiscal period
fiscal_period_id.description: Fiscal period associated with the statement.
fiscal_period_id.help: The period must belong to the selected fiscal year and condominium.

date_from.label: Start date
date_from.description: First day included in the statement period.
date_from.help: It follows the latest completed statement or defaults to the fiscal year start.

date_to.label: End date
date_to.description: Last day included in the statement period.
date_to.help: It is proposed as one calendar year minus one day after the start date.

posting_date.label: Posting date
posting_date.description: Date on which the statement must be posted.

document_id.label: Document
document_id.help: Select the source document received from the supplier.

has_shared_document.label: Shared document
has_shared_document.description: Indicates whether the consumption statement document is shared.
has_shared_document.help: Enable this option when the document has been shared.

consumption_meter_id.label: Legacy meter
consumption_meter_id.description: Former master meter linked to the statement.
consumption_meter_id.help: This optional hidden field is retained for existing data.

consumption_file_id.label: Consumption file
consumption_file_id.description: Configuration file used by the statement.
consumption_file_id.help: Changing it in draft preserves existing allocations and adds those of the new file.

fixed_share_heating.label: Fixed heating share
fixed_share_heating.description: Percentage of heating costs allocated as fixed costs.
fixed_share_heating.help: The fixed and variable shares together equal 100%.

has_deduct_advances.label: Deduct advances
has_deduct_advances.description: Indicates whether advances are deducted without creating allocation lines.
has_deduct_advances.help: Enable this option to deduct advances without creating allocation lines.

consumption_statement_calculation_lines_.label: Calculation lines
consumption_statement_calculation_lines_.description: Amounts calculated for property lots and ownership periods.
consumption_statement_calculation_lines_.help: Calculation lines are editable only in the to-encode status.

consumption_statement_allocation_lines_i.label: Allocation lines
consumption_statement_allocation_lines_i.description: Amounts allocated to accounting accounts and apportionments.
consumption_statement_allocation_lines_i.help: Allocation lines are editable in draft and proforma.

allocation_provider_information.label: Information to communicate
allocation_provider_information.description: Summary of the submission lines to communicate to the allocation provider.
allocation_provider_information.help: This text is synchronized with the submission lines and remains editable through the proforma stage.

statement_total.label: Statement total
statement_total.description: Total amount shown on the statement.
statement_total.help: Allocation and line totals are checked against this amount.

status.label: Status
status.help: The workflow allows returning to previous stages before integration.

form.default.name: Consumption statement
form.default.description: Maintain a consumption statement through its processing workflow.

route.add_attachment.label: Add document
route.add_attachment.description: Upload the original consumption statement document.

action.sync_submission_lines.label: Import sections
action.sync_submission_lines.description: Import consumption file sections as submission lines.

action.send.label: Send
action.send.description: Mark the statement as sent after checking allocations.

action.revert_send.label: Return to proforma
action.revert_send.description: Return the sent statement to proforma.

action.revert_mark_to_encode.label: Return to sent
action.revert_mark_to_encode.description: Return the statement to sent status.

action.generate_lines.label: Generate lines
action.generate_lines.description: Generate missing lines from configured property lots.

action.encode.label: Mark encoded
action.encode.description: Mark the statement as encoded after checking all totals.

action.revert_encode.label: Return to encoding
action.revert_encode.description: Reopen the statement lines for encoding.

action.unlock.label: Unlock
action.unlock.description: Cancel the related miscellaneous operations and return the statement to proforma.

errors.statement_not_draft: The consumption file can only be changed while the statement is in draft.
errors.allocation_provider_information_locked: Allocation-provider information can only be edited while the statement is in draft or proforma.
errors.missing_submission_line_apportionment: Every submission line must have an apportionment before the statement can be marked as proforma.
errors.invalid_status: Lines can only be generated while the statement is in the to-encode status.
errors.missing_allocation_apportionment: Every allocation must have an apportionment before the statement can be encoded.
errors.allocations_total_mismatch: The allocation total must match the statement total.
errors.lines_total_mismatch: The line total must match the statement total.
errors.missing_calculation_line_page_range: Every calculation line must have a page range before the statement can be encoded.
errors.invalid_calculation_line_page_range: Every calculation-line page range must start on a positive page and end on or after its first page.
errors.overlapping_calculation_line_page_ranges: A page cannot belong to more than one calculation line.
errors.missing_rounding_account: A rounding account is required to balance the statement allocations.
errors.missing_rounding_account_apportionment: The rounding account must have an apportionment.
errors.accounting_operation_already_exists: An accounting operation already exists for this statement.
errors.invalid_integration_status: Only encoded consumption statements can be integrated into accounting.
errors.missing_posting_date: A posting date is required for accounting integration.
errors.invalid_posting_date: Posting date cannot be in the future.
errors.missing_calculation_line_ownership: Every calculation line must have an ownership before integration.
errors.missing_calculation_line_property_lot: Every calculation line must have a property lot before integration.
errors.missing_misc_journal: A miscellaneous operations journal is required for integration.
errors.missing_consumption_statement_account: The consumption file must define an accounting account for integration.
errors.invalid_unlock_status: Only integrated consumption statements can be unlocked.
errors.missing_posted_misc_operation: No posted miscellaneous operation was found for this consumption statement.
errors.missing_fiscal_period: The miscellaneous operation must have a fiscal period.
errors.closed_fiscal_period: A consumption statement cannot be unlocked when its accounting period is closed.
errors.invalid_fiscal_year: A consumption statement cannot be unlocked when its fiscal year is closed.
